look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Find a large white, trumpet-shaped flower with a yellow throat; then inspect the broad, alternate, slightly rough-textured leaves and the persistent cup-shaped calyx around the developing fruit.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Evergreen to semi-evergreen shrub or small spreading tree; rounded crown and stout branching twigs.

key_traits.label: Leaves attachment
key_traits.text: Alternate, broadly ovate to elliptic, thick leaves; surfaces may feel rough or sandpapery; check petiole and leaf margins.

key_traits.label: Flower reproductive
key_traits.text: Large showy white funnel-shaped flowers with yellow center; inspect five spreading corolla lobes and calyx.

key_traits.label: Fruit seed
key_traits.text: Fleshy pale fruit enclosed partly by the persistent calyx; confirm fruit shape with a later close-up.

key_traits.label: Stem bud
key_traits.text: Woody twigs; inspect alternate leaf scars and young growth.
